plugin_desc: SNMP monitoring template for Netonix switch. It reports uptime, temperature sensors, fan speed, voltage sensors, total power consumption, DC/DC input current and efficiency, and interface traffic (enterprise PEN 46242). The MIB has no CPU or memory objects.
name: Switch

metrics.name: device_temperature_celsius
metrics.description: This metric reports each temperature sensor of the Netonix switch in degrees Celsius (NETONIX-SWITCH-MIB tempTable temp), labelled by tempDescription. High temperatures can indicate cooling failure or airflow obstruction and risk thermal shutdown.

metrics.name: device_fan_speed
metrics.description: Speed of each fan of the Netonix switch (NETONIX-SWITCH-MIB fanTable fanSpeed), one series per fan. Abnormally low or zero speed may indicate a stalled fan.

metrics.name: device_voltage_volts
metrics.description: Reading of each voltage sensor of the Netonix switch in volts (NETONIX-SWITCH-MIB voltageTable voltage, reported in hundredths of a volt and divided by 100 at collection), labelled by voltageDescription.

metrics.name: device_power_used
metrics.description: Total power consumed by the Netonix switch in watts, including PoE output (NETONIX-SWITCH-MIB totalPowerConsumption scalar, reported in tenths of a watt and divided by 10 at collection).

metrics.name: device_input_current_amps
metrics.description: DC/DC input current of the Netonix switch in amps (NETONIX-SWITCH-MIB dcdcInputCurrent scalar, reported in tenths of an amp and divided by 10 at collection).

metrics.name: device_dcdc_efficiency
metrics.description: DC/DC power supply efficiency of the Netonix switch in percent (NETONIX-SWITCH-MIB dcdcEfficiency scalar).

metrics.name: interface_ifHCInOctets
metrics.description: This metric indicates the average rate of bytes received over the past 5 minutes, measured in bytes per second, from the 64-bit IF-MIB ifHCInOctets counter (ifXTable). The 64-bit counter avoids the rapid wrap of the 32-bit ifInOctets on high-speed switch ports, keeping the rate accurate.

metrics.name: interface_ifHCOutOctets
metrics.description: This metric calculates the average rate of bytes sent over the past 5 minutes, measured in bytes per second, from the 64-bit IF-MIB ifHCOutOctets counter (ifXTable). The 64-bit counter avoids the rapid wrap of the 32-bit ifOutOctets on high-speed switch ports, keeping the rate accurate.

metrics.name: snmp_uptime
metrics.description: This metric indicates the uptime of the device since the last restart. By monitoring the uptime, network administrators can understand the stability and reliability of the device and identify potential reboot or failure issues.
